beats.narration: He froze the woman he loved
beats.caption: He froze the woman he loved,
beats.character: Victor (scientist); Nora frozen inside the chamber
beats.action: his hand on the frosted glass; inside, her still silhouette
beats.environment: cryo lab at night, blue glow
beats.camera_move: slow push from the glass to his face
beats.lighting: cold blue chamber glow, warm desk lamp behind
beats.sfx: low hum of machines, ice crackle

beats.narration: to save her life
beats.caption: He froze the woman he loved, / to save her life.
beats.action: looks up at her through the glass, gentle smile

beats.narration: Then his boss pulled the plug
beats.caption: Then his boss pulled the plug.
beats.action: a hand pulls a big lever; every light dies at once

beats.narration: This is Gotham City
beats.caption: Then his boss pulled the plug. / This is Gotham City,
beats.action: rain over a giant dark city; searchlights sweep the clouds
beats.lighting: sodium orange street glow, cold blue sky
beats.world_visual: Gotham City skyline: a dark city of towers

beats.narration: run by crime and money
beats.caption: This is Gotham City, / run by crime and money,
beats.action: cash changes hands in an alley under a neon sign

beats.narration: where a masked vigilante called Batman hunts criminals by night
beats.caption: run by crime and money, / where a masked vigilante called / Batman hunts criminals by night.
beats.action: crouches on a gargoyle; cape snaps in the wind as lightning flashes
beats.world_visual: a masked vigilante on a rooftop at night

beats.narration: Victor Fries was a scientist at GothCorp a giant company
beats.caption: Batman hunts criminals by night. / Victor Fries was a scientist at GothCorp, / a giant company.
beats.character: none (Victor tiny in a lit window)
beats.action: the GothCorp tower; push in to one lit lab window
beats.camera_move: push in to a high window
beats.purpose: a scientist at a giant company

beats.narration: His work was cryogenics freezing a living body
beats.caption: His work was cryogenics: freezing a living body,
beats.action: lowers a flower into a frost tank; it freezes solid
beats.world_visual: cryogenics shown: a flower frozen solid

beats.narration: so time stops inside it
beats.caption: His work was cryogenics: freezing a living body, / so time stops inside it.
beats.action: the frozen flower in ice; a clock beside it stops
beats.world_visual: time stopped: frozen flower, stopped clock

beats.narration: His wife Nora was dying of an illness
beats.caption: so time stops inside it. / His wife, Nora, / was dying of an illness
beats.character: Nora (pale, wrapped in a blanket) + Victor
beats.action: she coughs at the window; he holds her hand
beats.environment: their apartment at dusk, snow outside
beats.lighting: warm amber lamp vs blue window

beats.narration: no doctor could cure
beats.caption: was dying of an illness / no doctor could cure.
beats.action: stares at medical papers; his hand trembles

beats.narration: So Victor froze her in a glass chamber to wait for a cure
beats.caption: no doctor could cure. / So Victor froze her in a glass chamber, / to wait for a cure.
beats.action: she steps into the glass chamber; frost climbs the glass; their palms meet on the glass
beats.camera_move: slow crane up as the frost rises

beats.narration: He kept a snow globe with a tiny skater inside
beats.caption: He kept a snow globe / with a tiny skater inside.
beats.action: he winds a snow globe; a tiny skater turns; snow swirls
beats.lighting: desk lamp warm through the glass

beats.narration: To him it was Nora
beats.caption: with a tiny skater inside. / To him, it was Nora.
beats.action: watches the globe and smiles softly; her chamber glows behind him
beats.music: motif ends on a held note

beats.narration: But he'd used the company's machines
beats.caption: To him, it was Nora. / But he'd used the company's machines.
beats.action: the lab door bursts open; three silhouettes in the light

beats.narration: The boss Ferris Boyle ordered them shut off
beats.caption: The boss, Ferris Boyle, ordered them shut off.
beats.action: smiles coldly, points at the machines

beats.narration: Victor begged
beats.caption: The boss, Ferris Boyle, ordered them shut off. / Victor begged.
beats.action: Victor raises open hands, pleading; Boyle steps closer
beats.lighting: blue chamber light vs red alarm

beats.narration: Boyle kicked him into the freezing chemicals
beats.caption: Boyle kicked him into the freezing / chemicals, and ran.
beats.action: Victor flies back into a shelf of chemical tanks; glass shatters; white vapor explodes

beats.narration: and ran
beats.caption: chemicals, and ran.
beats.action: they run out; the door slams; vapor rolls across the floor

beats.narration: Nora's chamber went dark
beats.caption: Nora's chamber went dark.
beats.action: the chamber light flickers and dies; Victor's frozen hand slides down the glass

beats.narration: Victor believed she was gone
beats.caption: Nora's chamber went dark. / Victor believed she was gone.
beats.action: lies in frost on the floor, eyes open, unmoving

beats.narration: The chemicals changed his body
beats.caption: The chemicals changed his body.
beats.action: his skin turns pale blue; frost spreads up his neck; his eyes change

beats.narration: Now he could only survive below zero inside a frozen suit
beats.caption: The chemicals changed his body. / Now he could only survive below zero, / inside a frozen suit.
beats.action: in a dark workshop, bolts a refrigerated suit together; a glass dome helmet fogs
beats.purpose: he can only live in the cold

beats.narration: He became Mister Freeze
beats.caption: inside a frozen suit. / He became Mister Freeze,
beats.character: Mister Freeze (suited, dome helmet, cold gun)
beats.action: walks out of fog toward camera

beats.narration: and he hunted GothCorp to find the man who killed his wife
beats.caption: He became Mister Freeze, / and he hunted GothCorp / to find the man who killed his wife.
beats.action: fires the cold gun; a GothCorp truck freezes solid; alarms

beats.narration: Batman stopped him just before he froze Boyle alive
beats.caption: to find the man who killed his wife. / Batman stopped him just before / he froze Boyle alive.
beats.character: Batman + Freeze + Boyle (frozen to the waist)
beats.action: Freeze aims at Boyle; Batman drops in and knocks the gun away

beats.narration: Then he found the security tape
beats.caption: Then he found the security tape,
beats.action: slides a security tape into a player; on screen: Boyle kicking Victor

beats.narration: and gave it to the news
beats.caption: Then he found the security tape, / and gave it to the news.
beats.action: the footage plays on TVs in a shop window; Boyle, shivering, is exposed

beats.narration: That explains his revenge It doesn't excuse it
beats.caption: and gave it to the news. / That explains his revenge. / It doesn't excuse it.
beats.action: he is led away in restraints; he does not look back

beats.narration: Locked in a cell Victor held the snow globe
beats.caption: Locked in a cell, / Victor held the snow globe,
beats.character: Freeze (no helmet? keep helmet) in his cell
beats.action: sits on the bench, holding the snow globe
beats.environment: a cold cell, frosted walls, small window

beats.narration: and asked Nora to forgive him for failing her
beats.caption: Victor held the snow globe, / and asked Nora / to forgive him for failing her.
beats.action: the skater turns inside the globe; snow falls

beats.narration: He could freeze anything in the world
beats.caption: He could freeze anything in the world.
beats.action: snow begins to fall over Gotham; camera pulls out of the cell window

beats.narration: But the only thing he ever wanted to keep was her
beats.caption: He could freeze anything in the world. / But the only thing / he ever wanted to keep was her.
beats.action: memory: Nora laughing, setting the snow globe on the table; it fades into the cell's globe
beats.purpose: the only thing he wanted to keep
